question: Identify the artist who is NOT related to the musical instrument pakhwaj.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Kishan Maharaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pandit Kishan Maharaj** was a renowned tabla player from the Benares gharana, a prominent school of Indian classical music.
 
• He was known for his exceptional skill and dexterity in playing the tabla, a pair of twin hand drums.
 
• Pandit Kishan Maharaj was born in 1923 in Varanasi, India, and he became one of the leading exponents of tabla in the 20th century.
 
• He received numerous awards and honors, including the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan, for his contributions to Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pakhwaj:**

 
 
• The pakhwaj is a barrel-shaped drum used in Indian classical music, particularly in the Dhrupad genre.
 
• It is an ancient percussion instrument that has two heads, each producing different tones.
 
• The pakhwaj is played with both hands, and it requires a high level of skill and coordination.
 
• It is often used as an accompaniment to vocal and instrumental music performances in Indian classical traditions.
 
 
 
• **Ayodhya Prasad:**
 
 
• Ayodhya Prasad was a renowned pakhwaj player from the Nathdwara tradition.
 
• He is known for his contribution to the development and popularization of pakhwaj music.
 
 
 
• **Gopal Das:**
 
 
• Gopal Das was an eminent pakhwaj player associated with the Nathdwara tradition.
 
• He made significant contributions to the teaching and performance of pakhwaj music.
 
 
 
• **Totaram Sharma:**
 
 
• Totaram Sharma is a well-known pakhwaj player who has contributed to the promotion of this traditional instrument.
 
• He has performed extensively and is recognized for his skill in pakhwaj playing.
